A service must not depend on another service at the same layer.

What The Standard says

“Flow Forward” — The Standard explicitly prohibits services from depending on services at the same architectural level. Foundation services cannot call other foundation services, and orchestration services cannot call peer orchestration services; work must flow forward through the next appropriate layer. read it here.

Why it matters

The Flow Forward rule prevents peer services from forming lateral dependency chains. Moving composition to the next architectural layer keeps each service autonomous and stops changes, failures, and circular references from cascading sideways through a layer.

Bad code example

// Violates STX0004: A service must not depend on another service at the same layer.
internal class StudentProcessingService(
    ICourseProcessingService courses) : IStudentProcessingService { }

Good code example

// Follows STX0004
internal class StudentProcessingService(
    IStudentService students) : IStudentProcessingService { }
